deficits.evidence: A trodden strip of dirt and gravel runs alongside the road, with no paved or purpose-built sidewalk.
deficits.suggestion: Construct a paved, continuous footway on the left side to provide a safe, level surface for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: The area next to the roadside stalls is an unpaved, uneven dirt path, not a formal sidewalk.
deficits.suggestion: Build a paved footway on the right side, separating pedestrians from the road and the roadside stalls.

deficits.evidence: A white pickup truck is parked on the unpaved shoulder, obstructing the path for pedestrians.
deficits.suggestion: Enforce a no-parking zone on the left shoulder to keep the pedestrian path clear of vehicles.

deficits.evidence: Roadside market stalls and goods are set up on the unpaved path, blocking pedestrian access.
deficits.suggestion: Relocate the roadside stalls to a designated market area away from the pedestrian path.

deficits.evidence: The unpaved path is uneven, with visible dirt, gravel, and potential potholes.
deficits.suggestion: Grade and pave the left-side path to eliminate trip hazards and create a smooth walking surface.

deficits.evidence: The unpaved path is uneven and cluttered with debris from the nearby stalls.
deficits.suggestion: Clear debris and pave the right-side path to remove trip hazards for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: There is a high demand for crossing due to the market stalls and buildings, but no marked or purpose-built crossing is present.
deficits.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with a central refuge island to provide a safe place for people to cross the road.

deficits.evidence: No street lights are visible along the road in any of the frames.
deficits.suggestion: Install a series of street lights along both sides of the road to improve visibility and safety for all road users at night.

ratings.reason: The left side lacks a paved footway, and building one is a standard feasible fix.
The right side is unpaved and uneven, making a paved footway a viable solution.
A vehicle is clearly parked on the shoulder, obstructing the pedestrian area.
Market stalls are clearly encroaching on the roadside area.
The unpaved nature of the shoulder inherently presents trip hazards.
The right side is cluttered and unpaved, creating trip hazards.
No formal crossing is visible despite the presence of pedestrians and activity.
No street lighting poles are visible in the frames.
